billing_partition_invariant: full_input_tokens = input_uncached_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens; the three buckets are mutually exclusive

break_even_probability_units.break_even_failure_probability_per_compa: savings per execution divided by compactions per execution and loss per independently degraded compaction
break_even_probability_units.break_even_incremental_failure_probabili: savings per execution divided by loss per degraded execution

grain.break-even.csv: one long-session contrast, model, and failure-loss value
grain.scale-results.csv: one contrast, model, and algebraic volume

pricing_tier_rule: short when full_input_tokens <= model threshold; long otherwise; the selected tier prices the entire request
scale_rule: per-execution deterministic result multiplied by volume; no rows are materialized per execution
